earlier_failures.reason: QEMU 8.2 lacks reconnect-ms; minimal runner has no PXE ROM. No VM checks executed.
earlier_failures.fix: Use the disabled reconnect default and explicitly empty ROM filename.

earlier_failures.reason: Authenticated revoke passed all 10 checks. Egress-crash checked listener before the asynchronous supervisor shutdown barrier.
earlier_failures.fix: Require bounded supervisor termination before asserting listener absence; stream EOF remains independently required.

limits: No host LUKS/profile/manager lifecycle or compiled OpenCode execution in this matrix.
No real Tor bootstrap or Abliteration request in this matrix.
The authorized tools proxy is still unimplemented; global SOCKS support is not complete.
TCG is functional software emulation, not production KVM or physical-hardware isolation evidence.
Packet captures show emitted packets; blocked attempts need separate syscall/audit analysis.
All credentials and captured authentication are synthetic; these diagnostic artifacts are laboratory outputs, not runtime application logging.
CI artifacts are retained for seven days and are not signed release artifacts.
